name: Aluminium 7075-T6
description: Historical MIL-HDBK-5H A-basis tensile yield allowables demonstrating why one variant needs multiple conditioned observations. The cited sheet table groups T6 with T62 and the extrusion table groups T6 with T6510, T6511, and T62; consult the source and current specifications before design use.
